    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Bishop
    Represents the Bishop piece in chess.
    Board
    Reperesents the chess board and contains piece positions
    Board.BoardType
    Defines what type of board the board is -- currently only one type, which is default
    BoardUI
    Class for game window.
    Brick
    Represents the brick modifier.
    Client
    Represents the connecting player to a game
    Game
    The game, contains a board, stores the current turn, if the game has ended, the active modifiers and their locations, and the modifiers that will be offered.
    GameRunner
    Coordinates the start of a networked game session.
    King
    Represents the King in chess.
    Knight
    Represents the Knight piece.
    MainMenuUI
    Creates the main menu page for players to navigate around to either start a local game, host a game, or join a game using a game code.
    Modifier
    A custom data structure that represents any relevant data about a modifier, like name, type of modifier, pieces affected, etc.
    Modifier.Type
    Defines the type of modifier a modifier can be
    NetworkManager
    Manages the TCP connection between two players.
    NetworkManager.ModifierData
    Raw data carrier for a received modifier.
    Pawn
    Represents the pawn piece in chess.
    Piece
    The overarching structure for all chess pieces.
    Piece.Side
    Defines the side/color a piece can be
    Piece.Type
    Defines the types a piece can be
    Queen
    Represents the rook piece in chess.
    Rook
    Represents the rook piece in chess.
    Server
    Represents the host of the game, and allows the client class to connect using server sockets.
    Start
    Starts the game.
